name: Tendou Misato
source: Protagonist's mother and a widow whose husband recently died. She works at Yuri Kagami's coffee shop. She and her daughter rely on the protagonist who became the only man in the house.
translation: Protagonist's mother and a widow whose husband recently died. She works at Yuri Kagami's coffee shop. She and her daughter rely on the protagonist who became the only man in the house.
